agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: scale and breadth of technological significance

analytical_question: Is the technology incremental, breakthrough or potentially civilization-changing, and how much should broad significance affect this application decision?
general_et_finding: GenAI is potentially Promethean because it changes cognitive work across sectors, while the lender application remains incremental.
application_finding: Human-reviewed loan explanation and investigation-summary drafting is an incremental process improvement hypothesis within an existing lending workflow. Final underwriting, pricing and funding remain unchanged by scenario assumption. No local performance baseline establishes a breakthrough or 10X gain; borrower-facing consequences make verification important even when the innovation is incremental.
organization_specific_finding: The hypothetical midsize lender is a moderate fast follower with review staff, but permissions, measured benefit and review capacity are unverified. Broad GenAI significance justifies a learning agenda, not production approval. Human approval is a control to test, not proof that errors will be detected.

evidence.claim: The course framework uses a system gate, barrier/suppression test and six criteria; emerging cases have a potential rather than confirmed ceiling.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1: Andres Fortino, Chapter 11 Identifying Promethean Technologies, sections 11.2 and 11.7; supplied Prep Lab 5 course reading
evidence.notes: Not academic consensus or independent proof of GenAI significance. Restricted reading is not redistributed.

evidence.claim: A customer-support field study found a 14% average increase in issues resolved per hour.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2: Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, Generative AI at Work, NBER WP 31161, https://www.nber.org/papers/w31161
evidence.date_or_recency: April 2023; revised November 2023; source search extract checked 2026-10-19
evidence.notes: Historical working-paper estimate, not a current universal benchmark. Supports useful assistance, not 10X or removal of accountable human work. Direct page later returned 403; search-indexed original abstract was available.

evidence.claim: HBS reports task-dependent gains in an experiment with 758 consultants and a jagged capability frontier.
evidence.source_or_reference: S3: HBS AI Institute, Navigating the Jagged Technological Frontier, https://aiinstitute.hbs.edu/navigating-the-jagged-technological-frontier/
evidence.evidence_type: Research institution report of its experiment
evidence.notes: Supports useful capability in selected tasks; not proof of universal correctness. Full working-paper download returned 403, so no claim is made to have audited its methods.

evidence.claim: NIST identifies confabulation, privacy and human-AI configuration risks and recommends context-specific evaluation.
evidence.notes: Risk guidance, not lender performance data or legal certification.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Strongest case FOR a higher label: separating initial draft production from continuous expert composition could reshape both economic work and cognitive participation; S1 provides that mechanism and S2/S3 establish useful task capabilities. Cross-tier durability remains inference.
Strongest case AGAINST: the supplied studies demonstrate assistance inside existing workflows, not irreversible dependence across tiers; a human fallback remains plausible.

No verified 10X comparison, lender trial, population-wide access study or infrastructure suppression evidence is supplied. Historical evidence cannot establish October 2026 frontier-model performance.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence; long-term significance is uncertain.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially reduce drafting effort and broaden staff access to drafting assistance, conditional on quality and total review time. No measured savings or return is claimed.
risk_governance_implication: Incorrect or unsupported explanations could harm borrowers. Proposed controls: use approved source facts, trace draft statements to those facts, require trained review and log corrections. Compliance staff must separately assess applicable requirements; this agent does not certify them.
recommendation_management_implication: Approve design of an offline, time-bounded evaluation using authorized or synthetic records, with no borrower delivery. Compare total drafting-plus-review time and material factual errors against the existing workflow. Owners should set acceptance criteria before testing. Consider a limited human-approved pilot only after permissions, review capacity, quality and benefit are demonstrated. Broad significance alone never satisfies these gates.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess after a 90-day evaluation or earlier on a material unsupported statement or data incident.
Reassess broad classification when independently supported cross-tier dependencies, quality-adjusted 10X results, or durable access effects become available.
Reassess local fit when the model, data access, reviewer capacity or intended application changes.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Abstain from confirmed Promethean status and lender rollout approval.
Need authorized-data scope, error baseline, review burden and locally agreed quality thresholds.
